name: Finalize a feature (merge & close)
summary: The real finalize-feature.js pipeline that lands a committed feature branch on main: capture a pre-merge test baseline on main, open the PR if it is missing, merge origin/main into the worktree (HALT on conflict), run the post-merge suite and triage failures (HALT on regression), close the tickets and mark the source ACs done, merge the PR to main behind a confirmation gate, and finally archive the epic and remove the worktree. The destructive steps are gated and the pipeline halts rather than advancing when a merge conflicts or a regression is detected.

steps.label: Pre-merge baseline
steps.description: The test agent captures a test baseline on main before merging, so later failures can be triaged against a known-good starting point.

steps.label: Merge origin/main in
steps.description: The finalize pipeline merges the latest main into the feature worktree and halts on a conflict instead of advancing.

io_contracts.not_applicable: This step consumes Git refs and changes the worktree/index through git merge; conflicts are command output and repository state. It does not define a JSON merge result or silently serialize a new workflow DTO.

steps.label: Post-merge tests + triage
steps.description: The test agents run the post-merge suite and triage any failures against the baseline, halting on a real regression.

steps.label: Close tickets + ACs
steps.description: The finalize pipeline closes the tickets and marks their source acceptance criteria done in the store.

Output illustrative ac projection; not an execution receipt

steps.label: Merge the PR to main
steps.description: After the person confirms, the finalize pipeline merges the pull request into the protected main branch.

io_contracts.not_applicable: This is a human-gated GitHub merge action on an existing PR and Git branch, with a merge receipt/commit in GitHub/Git. This flow defines no Leafcutter JSON merge DTO and this documentation never grants merge authority.

steps.label: Archive + remove worktree
steps.description: Once the pull request is merged, AI agents archive the epic and remove the feature worktree.

io_contracts.not_applicable: This step moves Markdown epic/ticket files and removes the already-merged worktree after its checks. Inputs are verified Git/PR state and filesystem paths; output is archive placement, not a serialized JSON payload.

acceptance_scenarios.when: origin/main is merged into the worktree and a conflict occurs
acceptance_scenarios.then: the pipeline HALTS instead of advancing to the post-merge tests

acceptance_scenarios.given: a merged worktree and a pre-merge baseline
acceptance_scenarios.when: the post-merge suite runs and a new failure appears that is not in the baseline
acceptance_scenarios.then: it is triaged as a regression and the pipeline HALTS before the PR is merged

acceptance_scenarios.when: the PR is merged to main
acceptance_scenarios.then: the merge only proceeds after the confirmation gate is satisfied
